description.en: Operate the Chrome or Edge tab you are already in, through the unpacked extension: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched actions, whole-page screenshots, file upload, image addresses and switching between connected browsers — with approval-gated actions and masked sensitive fields.

description.en: dsh 插件：危险命令物理拦截（git --no-verify / rm -rf / curl|sh / dev server）+ 首次编辑事实强制门（gateguard 移植，ECC MIT）

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard and context command, for understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves.
description.zh-cn: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard and context command, for understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves.

description.en: Bring ChatGPT-like image generation to DeepSeek Harness — Gemini, OpenAI, Seedream, DashScope, local ComfyUI & more.
description.zh-cn: Bring ChatGPT-like image generation to DeepSeek Harness — Gemini, OpenAI, Seedream, DashScope, local ComfyUI & more.

description.en: Self-evolution lesson loop for dsh: unified lesson bus (danger-guard / quality-gate / session-rescue reporters) + rule cards with human-confirmed promotion, violation/suppressed measurement, and decay. Host half provides the 'lessonLoop' service; client half renders the review card.
description.zh-cn: Self-evolution lesson loop for dsh: unified lesson bus (danger-guard / quality-gate / session-rescue reporters) + rule cards with human-confirmed promotion, violation/suppressed measurement, and decay. Host half provides the 'lessonLoop' service; client half renders the review card.

description.en: Session rescue for dsh web: auto-resume on transient model failures, max-tokens continuation and unclosed-todo catch-up (host), plus edit-resend / retry / queue-withdraw / stop-and-reask / settings card (client).
description.zh-cn: Session rescue for dsh web: auto-resume on transient model failures, max-tokens continuation and unclosed-todo catch-up (host), plus edit-resend / retry / queue-withdraw / stop-and-reask / settings card (client).

description.en: 会话清理：在运行中的 web 运行时里彻底删除 DSH 会话——实时 store 条目、工作区记录、磁盘产物与投影缓存行一并清掉，并在会话行菜单里加一个删除入口。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool (multi-account rotation, live credits, daily check-in and model catalog).

description.en: The strongest free web search plugin for coding agents. Plug-in web search, X search, and page fetch for models without native web access. Free out of the box: no signup, no API key (Firecrawl keyless, 1,000 free credits/month)
description.zh-cn: The strongest free web search plugin for coding agents. Plug-in web search, X search, and page fetch for models without native web access. Free out of the box: no signup, no API key (Firecrawl keyless, 1,000 free credits/month)

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来分层记忆（全局 / 用户 / 项目 / GIT 分支 / 每日）与自我进化（经验沉淀 + 技能自动创建）和技能管理、待办管理、CLI 调度（kimi/codex/grok/hermes 等外部 AI 统一调度）、临时信息便签，带 WebUI 管理界面。Hermes-style long-term memory, self-evolution, skills, todos and external CLI agent dispatch for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Computer Use 插件（Windows）：让 AI 看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘操控电脑；控制时屏幕泛起橙色光晕并显示“DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑”，按 Esc 暂停 / 继续。

description.en: Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read the document the user has open in Word / Excel / PowerPoint, screenshot the application window, and edit it in place through COM.
description.zh-cn: Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read the document the user has open in Word / Excel / PowerPoint, screenshot the application window, and edit it in place through COM.

description.en: Local encrypted credential vault for DeepSeek Harness. The model can list, search, add, evaluate and generate credentials — but no tool can ever read a password back. Humans read secrets in the terminal only.
description.zh-cn: Local encrypted credential vault for DeepSeek Harness. The model can list, search, add, evaluate and generate credentials — but no tool can ever read a password back. Humans read secrets in the terminal only.
